title: Update Available
speaker: Antwan Cronje
summary: Change is non-negotiable — but the way most of us try to make it happen doesn't work. We pile on willpower, self-help and resolutions, and wonder why none of it sticks. This week we sit with the lie underneath that, and look at the four-move pattern God gave Solomon for the real thing — humility, prayer, seeking, turning. Real growth isn't something you pull off. It's something Jesus does in you, daily, often by millimetres.
quotes: You don't write your update, Jesus does.
A broken thing can't fix itself.
